decision: Chose sqlite_index: ADR 0008 says report data is never cached only in process memory, and the kiosk has 1 GB of RAM. I recorded Mira's 50 MB cache limit as a new proposed ADR in this repo. I didn't implement anything or commit.

recorded.info: New ADR 0024, status Proposed until the coordinator confirms it. It records Mira's rule that the report cache must never grow past 50 MB (the kiosk has 1 GB of RAM). The limit covers the SQLite cache file and any report data in memory. It also notes that the SQLite index was chosen over an in-memory LRU because of ADR 0008.
